outputs.notes: Added features/plan/utils/schoolDays.ts exporting `isOffDay(dayIndex, schoolDays?: DayOfWeek[])` and `DEFAULT_SCHOOL_DAYS` (Mon–Fri) as named exports — this is the shared source the next LessonTaskForm-touching phase (item 3) should reuse/import, not redefine. WeekGrid.tsx and WeeklyList.tsx now derive off-day styling from `useHousehold().householdProfile.schoolDays` via isOffDay() instead of a hardcoded isWeekend(dayIndex===0||6); both components had to start calling useHousehold(), so their integration test files (WeekGrid.test.tsx, WeeklyList.test.tsx) now mock '@/features/household/front/context' (standard project pattern, matches WeeklyPlannerPage.test.tsx). LessonTaskForm.tsx gained an optional `schoolDays?: DayOfWeek[]` PROP (not an internal useHousehold() call, to avoid breaking ~30 existing tests that render it without a HouseholdProvider) — its three real callers (LessonsPage.tsx, WeeklyPlannerPage.tsx, EditLessonModal.tsx) already call useHousehold() and now pass householdProfile?.schoolDays through. The warning is a dismissible amber inline box (role=status) shown when dueDate or plannedStartDate falls on an off day; it resets its dismissed state when either date changes; submission is never blocked. WeekGrid's drag-and-drop InlineSuccess message now appends '(an off day)' when the drop target is an off day (undoNotice gained an `isOffDayTarget: boolean` field). SchedulePage.tsx shows a small amber 'Off day' pill next to the page heading, only in day view, when selectedDate's weekday is an off day per household.schoolDays. CONFIRMED CLEAN (no fix needed): grepped features/schedule/front/components/WeekCalendarView.tsx and MonthCalendarView.tsx for isWeekend/getDay()===0/6 concepts — neither has any hardcoded weekend/off-day logic at all (WeekCalendarView lists days as plain rows with no per-day styling variance; MonthCalendarView only distinguishes in-month vs lead/trail-month cells), so per the plan's own instruction ('if not found, note that in write-back and skip') these two files were left untouched. Did not touch db/schema.ts, LessonGenerationPanel.tsx, or resources/server/service.ts (out of scope per plan). GradebookPage.tsx references LessonTaskForm only in a code comment, not an actual usage — no wiring needed there.
